messages:
Maria L.: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's ETL incident. Root cause summary: consumer offset jumps + aggregator inadvertently dropping null customer_id buckets => missing spans and skewed dashboards. We need owners + timelines for: (1) missing spans re-emission, (2) aggregation null-handling and backfill, (3) ETL backpressure alerts/runbook.

Alex K.: I can own the missing-spans re-emission work. Plan: add gap-detection in the trace consumer and re-emit spans for sequence gaps, create unit/integration test, and run a local replay. ETA: EOD Thu. I'll open a PR and a follow-up issue.

Sam R.: I'll take aggregation correctness (nulls collapsing groups). Likely cause: GROUP BY customer_id implicitly dropped nulls during map phase. Plan: null-safe grouping (coalesce) + regression tests + backfill script for the last 7 days. ETA: next Tue. I'll post the SQL and test plan in the issue.

Jess (oncall): Observed ETL lag spikes when scheduler retried batches; inflight tasks piled up. Action: add max_inflight cap and a high-severity alert for retry storms. I'll add a runbook entry for escalations and immediate mitigation steps.

Analytics Lead: We also need reconciliation tests on dashboards to detect these regressions automatically. Suggest nightly job that compares raw event counts vs aggregated counts and alerts on >1% drift. I'll coordinate QA and own the dashboard test coverage. ETA: 2 weeks.

devops-bot: Incident tracker updated: https://incident.internal.redwood/INC-2026-0319-ETL (follow-ups attached).

Alex K.: Implementation note/snippet for consumers:
```java
// detect sequence gap and re-emit span
if (detectedGap(lastSeq, currentSeq)) {
  reemitSpan(missingSpanPayload);
}
```
Test plan: replay kafka topic with synthetic gap and assert spans surface in tracing backend and latency histograms adjust.

Sam R.: Draft SQL for aggregation view fix:
```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW agg_by_customer AS
SELECT coalesce(customer_id,'_unknown') AS customer_id, sum(value) AS total_value, count(*) AS cnt
FROM events
GROUP BY coalesce(customer_id,'_unknown');
```
Backfill approach: compute diff window-by-window and apply idempotent upserts for the 7-day window.

Maria L.: Let's track all action items in a single GH epic so we can see ownership and timelines. Requirements: owner, ETA, PR/issue link, test plan. We'll review this follow-up in two weeks for recurrence checks.

Jess (oncall): Ack. Created GH epic and linked tasks: https://github.com/redwood/ops/issues/456 (owners assigned, added runbook section).

Analytics Lead: Also adding a nightly reconciler that emits a `reconciler.discrepancy` metric. Suggested alert: abs(agg_count - raw_count)/raw_count > 0.01 for >10m => paging.

Sam R.: I'll add the alert rule and a dashboard panel showing reconciliation trend.

Maria L.: Thanks everyone. Action items summary posted to the incident tracker. If there are no objections, we'll close the follow-up loop on 2026-04-10 and mark the incident postmortem follow-up as complete. Please update your tasks in the epic with PR/links as you make progress.
